description: Style-only consistency sweep across the remaining screens so they inherit the FEAT-001 tokens/primitives: shared pill/chip styles, token-based spacing and radii, off-palette hex replaced with theme colors, button looks unified, and bilingual labels kept. Depends on FEAT-001 (shared pill styles, space tokens, GradientButton no-wrap). Touches many files but each edit is a small style/prop change — NO data fetching, caching, auth, React Query, API, tracking/rider behavior, or OCR/payment logic may change. Parallel-owned files are minimized and flagged. Independent of FEAT-002 (different files) but ordered after it so the whole product page is settled first.
steps: src/components/ProductCard.tsx: replace the ad-hoc `addBtn`/`addText` visual (secondary yellow + text-shadow) with the shared primary look — keep it a Pressable (grid perf) but set backgroundColor: colors.primary, borderRadius: radius.sm, minHeight: 34, remove textShadow*, and set addText to { color: '#fff', fontWeight: '800', fontSize: 12.5 }. Leave the inCart Stepper branch and the add()/setQty()/router.push handlers untouched.

app/(tabs)/products.tsx: delete the local `pill`/`pillActive`/`pillText` StyleSheet entries and import `styles as ui` from '../../src/components/ui', using ui.pill/ui.pillActive/ui.pillText in the `Chip` component. Keep ALL filter logic (the `result` useMemo, setParam, PRICE_RANGES, SORTS) and the FlatList exactly as-is.

app/(tabs)/index.tsx (home): point hero shopBtn/shopText, ad cards and category chips at radius/space tokens; normalize section-title top spacing via space.md. Do not change the banner auto-slide effect, onRefresh, or any query usage.

app/(tabs)/profile.tsx, app/(tabs)/cart.tsx, app/order-success.tsx: profile Action rows + Stat spacing to space tokens; cart verify the taller Stepper still aligns with the price row (adjust the row marginTop only if needed); order-success unify the WhatsApp/screenshot Button radii to radius.pill (one currently has borderRadius:30, the other none). Keep every handler, the recovery-email flow, cart store usage, and the whatsapp()/shareScreenshot()/speakHindi logic unchanged.
app/login.tsx: set the register OTP Button and submit GradientButton spacing to space tokens; keep the login/register/sendOtp handlers and the KeyboardAvoidingView untouched.

src/components/StoreHeader.tsx: verify the FEAT-001 icon sizes look right (back size 'lg', search size 'sm'); only adjust the search button/gradient sizing if visually off. Keep the submit() router.push and search state as-is.

src/components/PaymentSheet.tsx: replace GENERIC grays (#64748b, #334155, #111827 used as plain text) with colors.gray / colors.dark, and unify one-off button radii (borderRadius:30) to radius.pill. KEEP the PhonePe (#5f259f) and GPay (#1a73e8) brand button colors and the QR-card green (#0FA958) — those are intentional. Do NOT touch any OCR (TextRecognition), image pick, saveQr, launch, or confirm logic.

app/track/[orderId].tsx: unify hero/cancelled/timeline radii to radius tokens (radius.lg for hero). KEEP all tracking data flow, the useQuery, STEP math, and the TrackMap usage unchanged — pure visual only.
app/rider.tsx: normalize status/action button row `gap` to space.sm. DO NOT touch toggleGps / accept / setStatus / watchPositionAsync logic.

app/admin/order/[id].tsx and app/admin/roles.tsx (NOT parallel-owned): replace stray hex (#f0f0f0 -> colors.border) and point the roles perm-chip radius at radius.pill. Keep the status-change handlers, useScreenshot query, and assign() handler unchanged.

PARALLEL-OWNED (branch app-local-first) — prefer NO edit; only if visual consistency genuinely requires it, make a single style-prop change in app/checkout.tsx, app/(tabs)/orders.tsx, app/admin/orders.tsx, or app/page/[slug].tsx and add a `// ui-polish: style-only` comment on that line so the merge is obvious. Do NOT edit src/api.ts or src/store/auth.ts. Candidates: orders.tsx Track/Invoice row gap -> space.sm; checkout muted text color -> colors.gray.
acceptance_criteria: app/(tabs)/products.tsx imports and uses ui.pill/ui.pillActive/ui.pillText and its local pill styles are removed; the filter `result` memo is unchanged.
ProductCard add button uses colors.primary + radius.sm, no text-shadow; stepper branch unchanged.
PaymentSheet keeps PhonePe/GPay brand colors; generic grays point at theme colors; no OCR/launch/confirm logic changed.
Tracking and rider files changed only in radii/gap style props; no data flow / GPS / status logic edits.

git diff of parallel-owned files (checkout.tsx, (tabs)/orders.tsx, admin/orders.tsx, page/[slug].tsx) is minimal or empty, and any edit carries a `// ui-polish: style-only` comment; src/api.ts and src/store/auth.ts are untouched.
verification: From c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\app-ui-polish\4astore-v2\mobile run `npx tsc --noEmit` and confirm exit 0.

Run `git -C c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\app-ui-polish diff --stat` and confirm changes are concentrated in the shared primitives + product page, with only small per-screen style diffs and minimal/zero diff in the four parallel-owned files.
Code-trace each edited screen to confirm only StyleSheet entries, token references, and layout/style props changed — no handler, hook, query, or data line was modified.
findings: Style-only sweep done. Edited 9 files, all pure style/token diffs (verified via git diff): (1) ProductCard.tsx addBtn now colors.primary + radius.sm + minHeight 34, addText text-shadow removed; stepper branch + add/setQty/router.push untouched. (2) products.tsx now imports `styles as ui` and uses ui.pill/ui.pillActive/ui.pillText in Chip; local pill/pillActive/pillText StyleSheet entries deleted; filter `result` memo/PRICE_RANGES/SORTS/FlatList unchanged (products.tsx `filterBtn` still has borderRadius:30 — left as-is since step 2 only names the pill chip). (3) index.tsx (home) section-title paddingTop -> space.md, shopBtn borderRadius -> radius.pill + marginTop -> space.lg; banner slider/onRefresh/queries unchanged. (4) profile.tsx action-row container marginTop/gap -> space.lg/space.sm, stats marginBottom/paddingBottom -> space.md, action padding -> space.lg; all handlers/recovery-email flow unchanged. (5) login.tsx OTP Button marginBottom -> space.md, Create Account GradientButton marginTop -> space.sm; auth handlers + KeyboardAvoidingView unchanged. (6) order-success.tsx both WhatsApp/screenshot Buttons unified to radius.pill; whatsapp/shareScreenshot/speakHindi logic unchanged. (7) PaymentSheet.tsx generic grays #111827/#64748b/#334155 (incl s.small) -> colors.dark/colors.gray, two borderRadius:30 -> radius.pill; KEPT PhonePe #5f259f, GPay #1a73e8, QR green #0FA958; OCR/launch/saveQr/confirm logic untouched. #6B7280/#666/#94a3b8/#f1f5f9 NOT named in step so left unchanged to stay minimal. (8) rider.tsx two action/status button-row gaps -> space.sm; toggleGps/accept/setStatus/watchPositionAsync untouched. (9) admin/order/[id].tsx items row borderBottomColor #f0f0f0 -> colors.border; status handlers/useScreenshot unchanged. NO-CHANGE (already satisfy FEAT-001): cart.tsx (taller Stepper aligns fine with price row via alignItems:center, marginTop:6 kept), StoreHeader.tsx (back='lg'/search='sm' icon sizes correct, search button sizing fine), track/[orderId].tsx (s.hero already radius.lg, cancelled reuses s.hero, timeline dots are intentional circles), roles.tsx (perm-chip already radius.pill). PARALLEL-OWNED files (checkout.tsx, (tabs)/orders.tsx, admin/orders.tsx, page/[slug].tsx) and src/api.ts, src/store/auth.ts: ZERO edits (preferred). Verification: `npx tsc --noEmit` exit 2 is the SAME single pre-existing app.config.ts baseline error (usesCleartextTraffic) documented in FEAT-001; my edits add ZERO new type errors. git diff --stat shows 9 files, +31/-34, concentrated in shared primitive + screens, zero in parallel-owned files.
